# hls-est tests and results (MEMOS decision #47; documented in hls-doc/tests.md).
#
#   check-hls-est       every lit test under test/hls-est: the hand-written
#                       Estimation and Passes tests, and the Mirror suite (one
#                       test per cgeist HLS lit test, generated by
#                       tools/hls-est-validate/mirror_cgeist_tests.py).
#   hls-est-results     runs the Mirror suite's hls-est commands and writes the
#                       Markdown results (test case -> prediction -> Vitis BRAM
#                       -> status) into hls-doc/test-results/.
#   check-hls-est-debug-invariance
#                       --bram-debug / --bram-debug-json change no estimate.
#   check-hls-est-all   all three.
#
# HLS_EST_RESULTS_JOBS sets how many hls-est processes the two Python targets
# run at once.

set(HLS_EST_RESULTS_JOBS 4 CACHE STRING
    "Parallel hls-est runs of the hls-est-results and debug-invariance targets")
set(HLS_EST_VALIDATE_DIR ${CIRCT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/hls-est-validate)

add_subdirectory(Plugins)

# The plugins test/hls-est/Plugins loads (--load-plugin): the test plugin and
# the in-tree copies of the examples under tools/hls-est-plugins.
set(HLS_EST_TEST_PLUGINS
  HlsEstTestPlugin HlsEstExamplePlugin HlsEstPolarFirePlugin)

add_lit_testsuite(check-hls-est "Running the hls-est regression tests"
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
  DEPENDS hls-est FileCheck not count ${HLS_EST_TEST_PLUGINS}
  )
set_target_properties(check-hls-est PROPERTIES FOLDER "Tests")

add_custom_target(hls-est-results
  COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${HLS_EST_VALIDATE_DIR}/make_test_results.py
          --hls-est $<TARGET_FILE:hls-est> -j ${HLS_EST_RESULTS_JOBS}
          --out-dir ${CIRCT_SOURCE_DIR}/hls-doc/test-results
  DEPENDS hls-est
  COMMENT "Writing the hls-est test results into hls-doc/test-results"
  USES_TERMINAL
  )

add_custom_target(check-hls-est-debug-invariance
  COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${HLS_EST_VALIDATE_DIR}/check_debug_invariance.py
          --hls-est $<TARGET_FILE:hls-est> -j ${HLS_EST_RESULTS_JOBS}
  DEPENDS hls-est
  COMMENT "Checking that the hls-est debug output changes no estimate"
  USES_TERMINAL
  )

add_custom_target(check-hls-est-all
  DEPENDS check-hls-est hls-est-results check-hls-est-debug-invariance
  )
